authorization: Mauricio's explicit Step 4 request: G1 no-climate only, preserve frozen V1, no automatic follow-up experiments.
roles: Unchanged BETA V1 target windows: train through Y-4; calibration Y-3; unused adaptation Y-2; selection Y-1; evaluation Y. Unchanged origin embargo.
training_population: G1: all eligible national municipalities, including original Meta/Tolima, strictly inside the original training role. National observations in all other roles are forbidden.
calibration_population: Exactly frozen V1 regional calibration keys, truths and predictors; same regularized pooled intercept penalty 1.
selection_population: Exactly frozen V1 regional selection keys and truths; unchanged tie-preserving budget threshold rule.
evaluation_population: Exactly frozen V1 regional evaluation keys/truths for OFF and R0; no intersection or post-result cohort substitution.
predictor_rule: Exactly the frozen BETA V1 positive predictor list minus its nine named climate variables; current zone encoded identically 0/1/2/3. No quality/geography/target field enters X.
cohort: Current non-excess, complete no-climate predictors, known exact-calendar onset T1/T2, approved horizon-specific national mask; original regional ON-complete cohort must equal its national no-climate projection in every role.

policy.denominator: Observed eligible target-month rows / 12; identical per paired comparison.
policy.threshold: Selection only; unchanged maximize detected onsets subject to budget, full ties, fewer false alerts, no-alert option.
policy.formal_adoption: Explicit Step 4 request before any V2 training; same adopted BETA V1 criteria.

support_rule: Each horizon/year needs two classes in pooled training and regional calibration, nonempty exact regional selection/evaluation, and at least one eligible nonregional training observation and municipality. Otherwise NO_EVALUABLE; never move dates. Count and disclose additional national classes, municipalities and first/last origin. 2020's limited June-2016-onward history is explicitly retrospective/seasonally incomplete support, not independent confirmation.
matched_control: Before training compare all regional role keys, no-climate X and onset truths exactly to V1 and frozen G0/R0 evaluation predictions. If identical, historical G0 is the exact regional control and G0_MATCHED is not needed. Any discrepancy blocks fitting until an explicitly identified matched-control protocol is frozen; no silent substitution.
hypothesis_rule: RESPALDADA requires descriptive joint compliance against R0 in every supported horizon/year/department and pooled horizon, with pooled G1 sensitivity strictly above G0 and FA load no higher in both horizons, plus no negative G1 sensitivity difference against G0 in any annual/department stratum. PARCIALMENTE_RESPALDADA requires at least one pooled horizon with strictly higher G1 sensitivity and no higher FA load against G0 but fails some joint guardrail. NO_RESPALDADA otherwise when paired cells are supported. NO_EVALUABLE if no paired admissible G1 cell. Do not rank by averages or declare statistical superiority.
publication: Separate immutable data/processed/exp_beta01_v2 bundle; models, predictions, metrics, policies, cells, preflight, protocol and provenance; no overwrite.
reproduction: Reload saved native models and fixed offsets; reproduce selection/evaluation probabilities, thresholds, alerts and metrics without fitting historical controls or refitting G1.
restrictions: No L1, climate ON, NB2, neural model, feature search, new alert policy or BETA02/03 V2.
2024 is consumed retrospective stress; 2025 is forbidden.
History support differs outside the 76 reference municipalities; adding eligible observations is not a causal estimate of municipality count alone.
Noninferiority statistical evidence UNAVAILABLE; superiority NOT_ESTABLISHED; G5 NOT_APPROVED; champion not_selected.
